tools.name: list_platforms
tools.title: List platforms and plans
tools.description: List available AgentsPodium engines (platforms) and hosting plans (tiers), with prices and capabilities.

minTier.description: Cheapest tier this engine can run on.

capabilities.description: Engine-specific capability flags, as published by the account API.

tiers.description: Available hosting plans (tiers) with prices, as published by the account API.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.title: List instances
tools.description: List the caller's AgentsPodium instances (agents): id, name, engine, tier, status, endpoint and A2A URL, domain, creation date. Never returns secrets.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: create_instance
tools.title: Create instance
tools.description: Create (deploy) a new AgentsPodium instance. Returns the instance id and, when enableA2A is true, the a2aUrl and a2aToken the caller should keep. After creating, poll get_instance_health until it is serving, then call set_llm_key to give it a working LLM key.

personaId.description: Persona/template id from list_platforms; defaults to the general-purpose persona.

engine.description: Runtime engine id (e.g. hermes, openclaw, n8n). See list_platforms for what's available.

tier.description: Hosting plan controlling RAM/CPU/disk. See list_platforms for prices.

model.description: Default LLM model id for the engine.

enableA2A.description: Turn on the A2A toolset and issue an a2aUrl/a2aToken for this instance.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain to serve the instance from.

extraSoul.description: Extra system-prompt instructions appended to the persona.

webhookUrl.description: Public http(s) URL to receive signed pod events (agent.running, agent.stopped, agent.failed, agent.deleted, payment.confirmed, deletion.warning) instead of polling. The signing secret comes back once as webhookSecret.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint, or null until assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A endpoint, or null if A2A was not enabled.

a2aToken.description: A2A bearer token to keep, or null if A2A was not enabled.

webhookSecret.description: HMAC key for webhook signatures when webhookUrl was given (shown once), else null.

next.description: Suggested next step for the caller.

tools.name: get_instance_health
tools.title: Check instance health
tools.description: Check whether an instance is reachable and serving, plus its status and quota state.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

status.description: Lifecycle status reported by the account API.

quotaStatus.description: Usage quota status, or null if not tracked.

reachable.description: Whether the instance's endpoint responded, or null if unknown.

serving.description: Whether the instance is currently answering requests, or null if unknown.

tools.name: get_instance_term
tools.title: Get billing term
tools.description: Get the billing term (trial/paid/grace) for an instance, including when it renews or expires.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

term.description: Billing term details (status, renewal/expiry dates, etc.), as returned by the account API.

tools.name: set_llm_key
tools.title: Set LLM key
tools.description: Set (or clear, with key=null) the LLM provider API key an instance uses to answer. Required before a freshly created instance can actually respond.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

provider.description: LLM provider id, e.g. openai, anthropic, deepseek.

key.description: The provider API key. Stored encrypted, never echoed back.

model.description: Model id to use with this provider (e.g. gpt-4o-mini). Optional; the engine defaults if omitted.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: pause_instance
tools.title: Pause instance
tools.description: Pause an instance: stops it and its billing lease. Data is archived, not deleted.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: resume_instance
tools.title: Resume instance
tools.description: Resume a previously paused instance, rebuilding it from its archive.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: rebuild_instance
tools.title: Rebuild instance
tools.description: Rebuild an instance's pod (e.g. after a config change that needs a restart).

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: delete_instance
tools.title: Delete instance
tools.description: Permanently delete an instance. This cannot be undone.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

tools.name: get_payment_options
tools.title: Get payment options
tools.description: Get ways to pay for an instance's plan: card/subscription buy links, crypto payment info, and Telegram Stars info (crypto and Stars are in beta testing), plus the instance's current term.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

providers.description: Card/subscription payment providers and buy links, as returned by the account API.

crypto.description: Crypto payment info (beta testing), as returned by the account API, plus an added 'note' field.

stars.description: Telegram Stars payment info (beta testing), as returned by the account API, plus an added 'note' field.

tools.name: set_peers
tools.title: Set A2A peers
tools.description: Set the list of other A2A agents this instance is allowed to call by name.

id.description: Instance (agent) id whose peer list is being set.

name.description: Name other agents use to address this peer over A2A.

url.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint URL of the peer agent.

token.description: Bearer token to send when calling this peer, if it requires one.

peers.description: Full replacement list of peer agents this instance may call (up to 20).

endpointUrl.description: Public HTTPS endpoint for the instance, or null if not yet assigned.

a2aUrl.description: A2A JSON-RPC endpoint for the instance, or null if A2A is not enabled.

domain.description: Customer-owned domain serving the instance, or null.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the instance was created.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.title: Set event webhook
tools.description: Register a URL that receives signed POSTs when the instance comes up, stops, fails, is deleted, when a payment is confirmed and before deletion for non-payment — instead of polling get_instance_health. Returns the HMAC secret once.

id.description: Instance (agent) id, as returned by create_instance or list_instances.

url.description: Public http(s) URL to POST signed pod events to. Private and loopback hosts are refused.
The webhook URL now in effect.

secret.description: HMAC-SHA256 key for X-AgentsPodium-Signature. Shown once — store it.

events.description: Event types that will be delivered.
